usage: Used to indicate having past experience doing something
Often placed before a verb or action
Implies the experience has happened at least once
Commonly used in casual spoken Cantonese

examples.jyutping: ngo5 si3 gwo3 sik6 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1
examples.meaning: I’ve tried eating at this restaurant.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 mei6 si3 gwo3 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6
examples.meaning: He has never lived alone before.
